Metrics.Name: m365.exchange.transport_rules
Metrics.Description: Exchange Online transport rules by state and rule mode. Disabled rules are counted too: a staged rule is one toggle from live. Which rule, and what it does, is on the m365.exchange_transport_rule log twin.

Metrics.Name: m365.exchange.transport_rules.redirecting
Metrics.Description: Transport rules that blind-copy, copy, redirect or add a recipient — a message reaching someone the sender did not address. An ENABLED one is the textbook business-email-compromise persistence shape and also emits an Error-severity log record naming the target.
